name: SBDS pseudogene 1

function.text: SBDSP1 is a pseudogene related to SBDS. Sequence homology makes it relevant to assay specificity and variant-mapping review; it should not be assumed to encode the functional SBDS protein.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: The gene appears in specialty educational coverage, but a disease-specific somatic driver relationship has not been assigned in this draft; expression-marker or assay-context mentions are not mutation evidence.
